title: Can you float?
content: I frequent my mall world every night, however the location changes. Sometimes I’m in Canada, Russia, North Carolina? There’s a lake, a hotel in which I live in, a mansion, and a mall and a parking lot. There is a train that takes me to paradise or a long unpaved road with things along the way. They lead to the same place. I normally in the middle of moving in or moving out. I have noted in my dreams I ask strangers if they can float, as it’s an uncommon trait in my world. If they say yes, I get excited and we go on an adventure together as it’s easier to travel if you can float. I see people I know in my dreams, but the ones I ask if they can float are always strangers, as I know the people I know don’t know I can float. It’s almost like I know it’s a secret. To clarify, to float I just mean levitate about 2-3ft off the ground. Move at a jogging/slow run, not like hyperspeed. It’s weird because I’m lucid in my dreams, but I don’t have control. Also, zero technology works. Not your phone, computer, nothing. That’s normally when I figure out when I am dreaming and become lucid.
